title: Studio copilot: the floating pending-drafts bar covers the copilot composer's input line in the right slot (objectui#12725's ruled artboard draws no bar there)
body:
Part of #12725. Filed by the `repo:cloud#2` seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#24145, session `session_01Cbdek8SKSHxddGqTPZXdqX`), which dispatches #12725 on the maintainer's order (「objectui #12724 和 #12725 你也负责派发。」). Source: the #12725 phase 6 dev report on PR #12964, out-of-scope finding 1 (class a, user-visible occlusion). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What was measured

- **Where:** Studio with the real build agent (cloud `BUILD_AGENT_NAME`, so `isBuildSurface` is true), at 1010 and 1280 px, once a copilot draft is pending.
- **What the user sees:** `ChatPane`'s floating `PendingDraftsBar` (`packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx`, rendered absolute at `bottom-20`, objectui#5694) sits over the copilot composer's input line in the right slot. It hides the placeholder and the first typed line.
- **Evidence:** branch `claude/issue-12725f-evidence` at `2301a354`, `evidence/12725f/`: `doors-1010-2-applied-card.png`, `doors-1280-2-applied-card.png`, `after-1010-slot-fits.png`, `after-1280-slot-fits.png`.
- **On `main` too:** the bar and its placement are untouched by PR #12964. Phase 5's live driver named its stub agent `studio_copilot`, which never drew the bar, so the earlier rounds did not see it.

## Governing text

#12725's rulings: 「按「右栏二选一」定稿」 with the `StudioRailCopilot` / `StudioRailProps` artboards as the final design. The artboards draw no pending-drafts bar in the right slot. The top bar already carries the 变更 badge (in sync with the copilot's drafts since phase 5) and 发布, and the applied card carries 查看变更并发布 / 撤销 (PR #12964).

## Target

Inside Studio's copilot slot the bar is not drawn: the top bar's 变更 and 发布 and the applied card are the ways to review and publish there. Outside Studio (the full-page chat and the console dock), the bar stays as it is.

## File surface

`packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx` (where `ChatPane` mounts `PendingDraftsBar`, keyed on the Studio host it already knows), tests beside it, a changeset.

## Acceptance

1. A test: in the Studio copilot with a pending draft, no `PendingDraftsBar` is rendered, and the composer's input is unobstructed. A control: the full-page chat with a pending draft still shows the bar.
2. Screenshots at 1010 and 1280 px in the Studio copilot with a pending draft: the composer's placeholder is visible whole.
3. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test` green.

## Dedupe

300 objectui issues (open and closed, by last update) scanned for `PendingDraftsBar`, "pending drafts bar", and 尚未发布 with composer or 输入: the only hit is PR #12964.
